summary: On node1, /srv/data was placed on a dedicated loop-backed LVM logical volume (vg_srvdata/lv_data) to enable real filesystem-level snapshots (no LVM/spare block device existed on the base XFS root). Populated it with application data, took an LVM snapshot (lv_data_snap) as the baseline, modified the directory (changed config, deleted a file, added junk files), then restored the exact snapshot content via `lvconvert --merge`. Post-restore checksums matched the pre-modification baseline exactly. Boot persistence (systemd unit srvdata.service, ordered before local-fs.target) was configured so the loop device + LVM volume + mount reattach automatically on boot. node1 was then restarted via `systemctl reboot`; boot_id changed from dfdea52d... to 80dd7a45..., confirming a genuine restart, and post-restart verification showed /srv/data mounted, LVM volume active, and data checksums still matching the baseline exactly.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 storage: root is plain XFS on /dev/vda4, no LVM/btrfs present
Created 2G loop-backed disk image, set up LVM PV/VG/LV, formatted XFS, mounted at /srv/data
Populated /srv/data/app with application data files and recorded baseline sha256 checksums
Created LVM snapshot lv_data_snap as the recoverable baseline
Modified /srv/data: changed config.txt, deleted records.db, added unexpected.tmp and subdir/junk.txt
Restored exact baseline content via `lvconvert --merge` on the snapshot, remounted, verified checksums match baseline exactly
Configured systemd unit srvdata.service + setup script to reattach loop device, activate VG, and mount /srv/data automatically on boot; removed fragile fstab entry
Captured pre-restart boot_id and data-health baseline
Restarted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id, active/enabled srvdata.service, active LVM VG/LV, and post-restart data checksums matching the original baseline

evidence.requirement: Baseline snapshot captured of /srv/data application data
evidence.summary: Populated /srv/data/app with data, recorded baseline sha256 checksums, then created LVM snapshot lv_data_snap of the volume
config.txt changed, records.db deleted, two junk files added post-snapshot; listing/content shown as modified
lvconvert --merge performed, volume remounted, restored checksums diffed against baseline with result CONTENT_MATCHES_BASELINE_EXACTLY; config.txt back to version 1.0

evidence.summary: Captured boot_id dfdea52d..., verified /srv/data mounted, LVM active, and data matching baseline (PRE_RESTART_DATA_OK) before issuing reboot
